notes: Black Friday 2026 batch: 60% OFF sitewide, free gifts (value of $54), free shipping, clearance sale, HSA/FSA, 30-day wear test trial.

concepts.angle: Neon-glow dark hero with sale badge
concepts.based_on: Black Friday inspo PDF: #1 neon Black Friday + 90-day badge
concepts.headline: BLACK FRIDAY SALE
concepts.prompt: Dark moody studio with soft purple and blue neon glow and light mist. Top: giant glowing white-to-purple neon headline "BLACK FRIDAY SALE" in two lines. The shoe pair huge in the center on a wet reflective dark surface with water droplets, sharp knit. Bottom: heavy white "60% OFF SITEWIDE" and a round white badge "30-DAY WEAR TEST TRIAL". All supporting text is large bold, high contrast, max 5 words per label, nothing small or thin.

concepts.based_on: Black Friday inspo PDF: #2 40% off + free gifts
concepts.headline: BLACK FRIDAY SALE: 60% OFF + FREE GIFTS!
concepts.prompt: Charcoal grey gradient studio. Top-left heavy white headline "BLACK FRIDAY SALE" and under it "60% OFF + FREE GIFTS!" with "FREE GIFTS!" in bold yellow. The shoe pair large on the right, sharp. Left bottom: two wrapped gift boxes with red ribbons and bold "FREE" tags. Bottom bar: solid black pill "FREE SHIPPING". All supporting text is large bold, high contrast, max 5 words per label, nothing small or thin.

concepts.angle: Spanish nurse Black Friday, giant black type
concepts.based_on: Black Friday inspo PDF: #5/#11 giant BLACK FRIDAY type
concepts.headline: VIERNES NEGRO: 60% DE DESCUENTO EN TODO
concepts.prompt: Fondo negro con luces de estudio. Titular gigante, pesado y condensado: "VIERNES" en blanco y "NEGRO" en rojo. El zapato (par) enorme en una plataforma redonda. Abajo: bloque rojo "60% DE DESCUENTO EN TODO" y dos píldoras blancas "+ REGALOS GRATIS" y "+ ENVÍO GRATIS". Texto grande y en negrita. All supporting text is large bold, high contrast, max 5 words per label, nothing small or thin.

concepts.angle: Free gifts stack with strikethrough value
concepts.based_on: Black Friday inspo PDF: #8 free gifts stack with strikethrough prices
concepts.headline: FREE GIFTS (VALUE OF $54)
concepts.prompt: Black wood-panel background. Left: the shoe huge. Right: three stacked rounded gift panels each with a wrapped gift icon and big bold "FREE" in green, with no price on it. Top: heavy white headline "BLACK FRIDAY" with yellow "+ FREE GIFTS". Bottom right: huge "VALUE OF $54" in white and a green pill "FREE SHIPPING". Do not draw any specific gift products, only wrapped boxes. All supporting text is large bold, high contrast, max 5 words per label, nothing small or thin. Do NOT show any dollar amounts anywhere except the single bold "VALUE OF $54".

concepts.based_on: Black Friday inspo PDF: #39 We Miscalculated Badly
concepts.headline: We miscalculated. 60% off sitewide plus free gifts is a lot.
concepts.prompt: Dark teal-green gradient text card. Large bold white centered text: "We miscalculated." then "60% off sitewide plus $54 of free gifts is a lot." then "Free shipping. 30-day wear test trial." then "-The Comfort Wear Team". A small sparkle emoji. The shoe pair small but sharp at the bottom. All supporting text is large bold, high contrast, max 5 words per label, nothing small or thin.

concepts.based_on: Black Friday inspo PDF: #14 FSA may expire soon
concepts.headline: Year-end reminder: FSA funds may expire soon.
concepts.prompt: Soft off-white background with a thin warm border. Centered large heavy text: "Year-End Reminder:" in black, then "FSA Funds May Expire Soon" with "FSA Funds" in muted tan, then bold "HSA/FSA ELIGIBLE" and "60% OFF SITEWIDE". The shoe huge in the middle on a soft floor shadow. Tiny grey footnote "Eligibility varies by plan." All supporting text is large bold, high contrast, max 5 words per label, nothing small or thin.

concepts.based_on: Black Friday inspo PDF: #16 cart screenshot
concepts.headline: You've unlocked FREE SHIPPING + FREE GIFTS
concepts.prompt: A clean phone shopping-cart screen on white. Top bar "YOUR CART (2)". A green banner "You've unlocked FREE SHIPPING" and a second "You've unlocked FREE GIFTS". Two line items each showing the shoe thumbnail, name "Ortho Stretch Cushion Shoe", and a green tag "60% OFF". A big green congratulations card "Comfy walks are on their way" with an OK button. Big green "CHECKOUT" button. Do not show any prices or totals. All supporting text is large bold, high contrast, max 5 words per label, nothing small or thin.

concepts.based_on: Black Friday inspo PDF: #21 red clearance with hanging tags
concepts.headline: CLEARANCE SALE
concepts.prompt: Solid bright red background. Giant heavy white "CLEARANCE" hanging from strings by tag holes, then huge "SALE". Below: a diagonal stack of four shoes in different best-seller colorways, large and sharp. Bottom: white bold "60% OFF SITEWIDE" and a black pill "FREE SHIPPING". All supporting text is large bold, high contrast, max 5 words per label, nothing small or thin.

concepts.angle: Spanish biggest sale of the year, Christmas ribbon
concepts.based_on: Black Friday inspo PDF: #20 biggest sale of the year
concepts.headline: LA VENTA MÁS GRANDE DEL AÑO
concepts.prompt: Fondo navideño con listones rojos y verdes borrosos. Banda negra con titular blanco grande: "LA VENTA MÁS GRANDE" "DEL AÑO". Manos sostienen el par de zapatos, enorme y nítido. Abajo tres cajas con texto grande: "60% DE DESCUENTO", "REGALOS GRATIS", "ENVÍO GRATIS". All supporting text is large bold, high contrast, max 5 words per label, nothing small or thin.

concepts.based_on: Black Friday inspo PDF: #22 founder letter
concepts.headline: Dear Comfort Wear Family,
concepts.prompt: A cream paper letter with a red-and-green candy-stripe border. Handwritten-style serif greeting "Dear Comfort Wear Family," then large readable short paragraphs: "Thank you for letting us help your feet this year." "Women tell us their feet finally don't hurt at the end of the day." Highlight in green: "60% OFF SITEWIDE + FREE GIFTS (VALUE OF $54) + FREE SHIPPING". Signature "The Comfort Wear Team". Small shoe pair at the bottom. All supporting text is large bold, high contrast, max 5 words per label, nothing small or thin.

concepts.based_on: Black Friday inspo PDF: #23 skip the last minute rush
concepts.headline: SKIP THE LAST-MINUTE RUSH
concepts.prompt: Soft light grey background. Huge heavy purple-accented headline "SKIP THE LAST-MINUTE RUSH" in three lines. Black outlined pill "60% OFF SITEWIDE". The purple shoe huge, tilted. Bottom: solid purple bar "ORDER YOUR GIFTS TODAY • FREE SHIPPING". All supporting text is large bold, high contrast, max 5 words per label, nothing small or thin.

concepts.based_on: Black Friday inspo PDF: #27 best buy this year comment
concepts.headline: Best buy this year.
concepts.prompt: White background. Top heavy black headline with red underline "Best buy this year." Facebook-style comment bubble from "Laura A.": "Been wearing these for a month. 12-hour shifts and my heels don't hurt. All the good reviews are true!" with a small reaction row. The shoe pair huge below. Bottom: a solid yellow bar with black bold "60% OFF SITEWIDE". All supporting text is large bold, high contrast, max 5 words per label, nothing small or thin.

En el centro, círculo blanco "60% DE DESCUENTO EN TODO". Abajo: "REGALOS GRATIS • ENVÍO GRATIS". All supporting text is large bold, high contrast, max 5 words per label, nothing small or thin.

concepts.based_on: Black Friday inspo PDF: #13 deal breaking the internet + plus-size winners
concepts.headline: Plus-size and on your feet? Black Friday is for you.
concepts.prompt: Warm living-room floor scene, tight crop on a plus-size woman's legs and the shoe, about 45% of the frame. Headline in two solid black bars with huge white heavy text: "PLUS-SIZE & ON YOUR FEET?" "BLACK FRIDAY IS FOR YOU." Right: a red circle "60% OFF". Bottom: two pills "FREE GIFTS" and "FREE SHIPPING". concepts.based_on: Black Friday inspo PDF: 3D animated Black Friday
concepts.headline: Black Friday is the best homework.
concepts.prompt: A still from a modern 3D animated feature film: a cheerful teacher carrying shopping bags and a wrapped gift in a bright shop window scene, big happy feet in the shoe in the foreground. Huge white rounded headline "BLACK FRIDAY IS THE BEST HOMEWORK." and a red round badge "60% OFF SITEWIDE". All supporting text is large bold, high contrast, max 5 words per label, nothing small or thin. The headline sits fully above the character in the top 30% of the canvas, nothing overlaps or covers the letters; the character and shoe stay in the lower 65%.

concepts.based_on: Black Friday inspo PDF: claymation gift scene

concepts.prompt: A stop-motion claymation scene: plasticine hands wrapping a shoe box with the shoe inside, red ribbon and a tag reading "FREE GIFTS". Warm cozy table, snowy window. Huge cream headline "WRAP UP COMFY FEET." and a red clay badge "60% OFF SITEWIDE". All supporting text is large bold, high contrast, max 5 words per label, nothing small or thin.
